extracted.name: Cajun Butter Sauce
extracted.description: This Cajun butter sauce is simple to throw together and perfect for dipping shrimp or any seafood of choice. A little bit of heat and a whole lot of love.
ingredient_lines: 2 teaspoons seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Add onion, lemon juice, seafood seasoning, garlic, hot sauce, and parsley flakes.
Cook for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.
